<script>
/* 佐口史料ギャラリー：10秒ごとに別の所蔵資料へ差し替え（画像・見出し・説明・リンクを目録データと一致させる） */
(function(){
  var wrap=document.getElementById('saguchi-gallery');
  if(!wrap) return;
  var cards=Array.prototype.slice.call(wrap.querySelectorAll('.gcard:not(.gcard--more)'));
  if(!cards.length) return;
  var reduce=window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  function shuffle(a){for(var i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){var j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));var t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;}return a;}
  function metaOf(it){
    var parts=[];
    var lab=it.typ||it.cat||it.group||'';
    if(lab) parts.push(lab);
    var era=(it.grps&&it.grps['年代'])||'';
    if(!era||era==='年代不明'){ era=(it.era&&it.era.length<=10)?it.era:''; }
    if(era&&era!=='年代不明') parts.push(era);
    return parts.join('／');
  }
  function apply(card,it){
    var img=card.querySelector('img'),
        gt=card.querySelector('.gt'), gm=card.querySelector('.gm');
    card.setAttribute('href','/c019.html#'+it.id);
    if(img){ img.src='/'+it.img; img.alt=(it.name||'佐口行正氏所蔵史料')+' 佐口行正氏所蔵資料'; img.loading='lazy'; img.decoding='async'; }
    if(gt) gt.textContent=it.name||'佐口行正氏所蔵史料';
    if(gm) gm.textContent=metaOf(it)||'佐口行正氏所蔵資料';
  }
  fetch('/data/saguchi-shiryo.json').then(function(r){return r.json();}).then(function(d){
    var pool=(d.items||[]).filter(function(it){return it&&it.img&&it.id&&it.id!=='hk-20';});
    if(pool.length<=cards.length) return;
    shuffle(pool);
    var idx=0;
    function nextBatch(){
      for(var k=0;k<cards.length;k++){
        if(idx>=pool.length){ shuffle(pool); idx=0; }
        apply(cards[k],pool[idx++]);
      }
    }
    function tick(){
      if(reduce){ nextBatch(); return; }
      cards.forEach(function(c){c.classList.add('is-fade');});
      setTimeout(function(){ nextBatch(); cards.forEach(function(c){c.classList.remove('is-fade');}); },550);
    }
    setInterval(tick,10000);
  }).catch(function(){});
})();
</script>

    if (/^\/t/.test(url)) return 'area-toyoda';
    if (/^\/s/.test(url)) return 'area-nanbu';
    if (/^\/k/.test(url)) return 'area-koyo';
    if (/^\/r/.test(url) || /^\/area\/ryuyo/.test(url)) return 'area-ryuyo';
    if (/^\/f/.test(url)) return 'area-fukude';
    if (/^\/y/.test(url)) return 'area-toyooka';
    return '';
  }
  function newArticleDistrict(item){
    var cls = newArticleAreaClass(item);
    if (!cls) return '';
    return cls.replace(/^area-/, '');
  }

  function collapseSeries(items){
    // 「（特集・全Nページ公開）」の代表ページに続く同日公開の後続ページは、
    // トップの新着表示では代表ページ1件にまとめる（下層のupdates.htmlでは個別表示のまま）。
    var out = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++){
      var it = items[i];
      if (it.__consumed) continue;
      out.push(it);
      var m = it.title.match(/特集.*?全(\d+)ページ/);
      if (m){
        var need = parseInt(m[1], 10) - 1;
        var j = i + 1;
        while (need > 0 && j < items.length && items[j].date === it.date){
          items[j].__consumed = true;
          need--; j++;
        }
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  fetch('/data/new-articles.json?t=' + new Date().getTime())
    .then(function(res){ return res.json(); })
    .then(function(data){
      data.sort(function(a, b){
        if (a.date < b.date) return 1;
        if (a.date > b.date) return -1;
        var ap = a.published_at || '';
        var bp = b.published_at || '';
        if (ap < bp) return 1;
        if (ap > bp) return -1;
        return 0;
      });
      data = collapseSeries(data);
      var list = document.getElementById('new-article-list');
      if (!list) return;
      list.innerHTML = '';
      data.slice(0, 14).forEach(function(item){
        var li = document.createElement('li');
        li.className = 'new-article-item news-item';
        var district = newArticleDistrict(item);
        if (district) li.setAttribute('data-district', district);

        var a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = item.url;
        a.className = 'new-article-link news-link';
        var areaClass = newArticleAreaClass(item);
        if (areaClass) a.classList.add(areaClass);

        var metaSpan = document.createElement('span');
        metaSpan.className = 'news-meta';

        var dateSpan = document.createElement('time');
        dateSpan.className = 'new-article-date news-date';
        dateSpan.dateTime = item.date;
        dateSpan.textContent = item.date;

        var catSpan = document.createElement('span');
        catSpan.className = 'new-article-category news-tag';
        catSpan.textContent = item.category;

        var titleSpan = document.createElement('span');
        titleSpan.className = 'new-article-title news-title';
        titleSpan.textContent = item.title;

        metaSpan.appendChild(dateSpan);
        metaSpan.appendChild(catSpan);
        a.appendChild(metaSpan);
        a.appendChild(titleSpan);

        var arrow = document.createElement('span');
        arrow.className = 'new-article-arrow news-arrow';
        arrow.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        arrow.textContent = '→';
        a.appendChild(arrow);

        li.appendChild(a);
        list.appendChild(li);
      });
    })
    .catch(function(err){
      console.error('Failed to load new articles:', err);
    });
})();
</script>
